issues.claim: Priority One Locksmith (Old Bridge Township, keyword domain priorityonelocksmith.com)
issues.problem: The site itself is written like a locksmith lead-generation network, not a local shop: it advertises a flat '$15 service fee', '100% mobile' vans 'dispatched through an advanced GPS system', no street address, no NJ license number, no named principal. The mapper correctly removed 'Old Bridge Towing' as lead-capture but kept this one without the same caveat.
issues.fix: Keep only if flagged as unverified lead-gen; it is not a qualified prospect until a street address or NJ locksmith license is confirmed. Apply the same treatment to Old Bridge Locksmiths and Old Bridge Garage Door Repair, which the entries already flag.

issues.claim: M&B Handyman Services (5 Everly St) and Big B's Handyman Service (45 Alpha Ave) rest on one weak listing each
issues.problem: The cited Yahoo URL is a Freehold handyman category page on which the business details are not rendered in the page text (only an image caption naming it). The business does check out at 5 Everly St, Old Bridge, (908) 395-8979 via a search result for that URL, and Big B's checks out at 45 Alpha Ave via a Porch listing - but neither could be confirmed by opening a page that states them.
issues.fix: Leave in, but cite a source that actually prints the address (BuildZoom / Porch profile) so the record is auditable.

issues.claim: Service-area entries whose base town is elsewhere (Bob Zeffiro, Asch Roofing, All-State Power Washing, C&R Inspired Landscaping, etc.)
issues.problem: Roughly a third of the list is firms that merely market to Old Bridge. This is disclosed in the notes and is a legitimate judgement call, but the 10-mile zone rule makes it a triage risk: several (e.g. Bob Zeffiro, published on its own contact page as serving Matawan first) are probably outside the zone's base.
issues.fix: No change required for this pass - keep the 'service area only' flag and let triage drop them; do not count them in the qualified-prospect total.
